title: Qualification evidence and autobuilder boundary
summary: Static metadata, shell syntax, archive structure, and contract checks can be run in the chat; native ooRexx and a real browser must be run on an execution-capable host. Until there is a PASS receipt, Git transport is SOURCE_PRESENT, not accepted.
invariants: Autobuild integration uses schema 0.3, tests argv and publish.tree path packages/alchemy_event_continuation_v0.1-dev4.
Canonical Git submit uses an autobuild-submit branch, complete package-tree commit first and ready.json second.
Do not merge the submission branch or claim a PASS without autobuild/receipts/<submission_id>.json.
No live ChatGPT conversation submission or message delivery has been tested.

provenance.claim: Development source candidate; qualification state explicitly bounded.
